name: experimental_qwen35_matrix_norm_rope_all_head_token_window_v1
architecture: Existing qwen2_projection_tile16_controller default-off candidate; same Revision8B-B 512-lane Matrix endpoint and 4x6144x64-byte SharedL2 fabric; no replacement top
dtype: Raw BF16 H1024 activation and actual BF16 checkpoint weights; ascending K0..1023 sequential FP32 FMA, terminal BF16-RNE, Norm256 policy0xc1 and partial64 all-products-BF16 RoPE policy0xb1
owner_interface: One accepted Command128 descriptor plus snapshotted candidate sideband executes all heads of one role for a checked token window; does not add a generic Command128 opcode or complete full-block owner
token_range: 1 <= count <= 128, start+count <= descriptor M <=128; addition checked at33bits before traffic; tensor head start must be0
iteration: token-major, ascending head, ascending32-column Matrix tile; Q16tiles/head,K8tiles/head; two engine-reset clocks betweenheads
counters: Legacy six-bit column_tiles reports bounded per-head16Q/8K only. Explicit eight-bit total_column_tiles reports128Q/16K pertoken. completed_heads16bits and completed_tokens8bits advance only after every packed,Norm,RoPE storeACK for the head/token
staging: Fixed single-head packed1024Q/512K,Norm512,RoPE512 bytes; activation/weight each64KiB, gamma512bytes and128bytes/token trig table. No whole-tensor buffers or resource widening
position_coefficients: Explicit immutable BF16 cos32/sin32 table at trig_base + absolute within-window source token index *128; coefficients from official cold position0/1 and carried position254/255. Generation/cache integration remains open
external_layout: Packed output in descriptor DDR tensor: Q8192,K1024byte tokenstrides. Norm/RoPE explicit DDR whole-tensor bases: Q4096,K1024byte tokenstrides;512byte headstride. Q gate stays raw in packed output
ownership: One outstanding descriptor,DMA,L2read and L2write owner each. Norm/RoPE stores each8rows x64bytes. All stores mustACK before staging reuse or done. Norm/RoPE arithmetic exception flags OR acrossheads (Matrix intermediate/conversion flags are not exported); first fatalstatus terminates; reset also flushes external fabric and does not roll back writes
preflight: Full selected DDR windows for activation,allweightcolumns,packed,Norm,RoPE are pairwise disjoint,aligned and within56bitDDR. Seven fixed local staging/trig regions pairwise disjoint and within true1572864byteL2. All arithmetic checked before truncation
numerical_gate: Independent integer dyadic seqFMA/Norm/RoPE plus separate C fmaf/node reference must match actual RTL bitwise; native source comparison keeps max_abs<=0.03125,mean_abs<=0.005. Preserve each failure and never substitute oracle agreement for native acceptance
artifact_policy: Source,pins,hashes,shortsummary only inGit/CI artifact. Checkpoint payloads,NPZ,memh,traces,generatedRTL,binaries rebuilt transiently inwork/
